title: Animator Trigger
description: Component that triggers animations based on events.
content:
Animator Trigger

Component that triggers animations based on events.

Component Common

Schema

JSON
{
  "animatorTrigger": {
    "animations": {
      "eventName": "animationName"
    }
  }
}

Description

The Animator Trigger component triggers animations based on events. It maps event names to animation names, so when a specific event is fired, the corresponding animation is played automatically.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
animationsDictionary{string, string}Maps event names to animation names. When the event fires, the mapped animation is triggered.

Example

JSON
{
  "animatorTrigger": {
    "animations": {
      "onDamage": "hurt",
      "onJump": "jump",
      "onLand": "land"
    }
  }
}
